tagline: IPO day as a launch sequence: open at $150, rip toward orbit, then survive first-day gravity.

headlines.title: SpaceX begins trading on Nasdaq under SPCX after pricing its IPO at $135
Shares open near $150, an 11% liftoff from IPO price
Retail demand and scarce float turn the first minutes into a rocket burn
Valuation debate ignites over Starlink, Starship, AI ambitions, and cash burn
SPCX tags its first-day high as traders chase the biggest IPO story on Earth
Volume surges past hundreds of millions of shares as SPCX price discovery gets violent
Gravity check: first-day profit taking shakes out the launch tourists
Closing burn: SpaceX ends day one at $160.95, about 19% above IPO price
